documents.title: NSTFDC FAQ - Term Loan Scheme for ST Entrepreneurs
documents.text: The National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC) provides Term Loans for Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals/entrepreneurs for viable income-generating projects costing up to ₹50.00 lakh. Maximum loan assistance is 90% of unit cost. Interest rate is 6% per annum for loans up to ₹5 lakh, and 8% per annum for loans above ₹5 lakh. Repayment tenure is up to 10 years including moratorium up to 1 year.

documents.title: NSTFDC FAQ - Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMES)
documents.text: Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMES) is an exclusive concessional scheme for Scheduled Tribe (ST) women entrepreneurs. Unit cost up to ₹2.00 lakh per beneficiary. Loan assistance is 90% of unit cost at a highly subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum. Repayment is in quarterly installments over 5 years including a 6-month moratorium.

documents.title: NSTFDC FAQ - Micro Credit Scheme for Self Help Groups (MCS)
documents.text: Micro Credit Scheme for ST Self Help Groups (SHGs) provides credit for micro-enterprises. Maximum loan per SHG is ₹5.00 lakh, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000 per member. Interest rate charged to SHGs is 6% per annum. Repayment is within 5 years.
